items.title: Reggie Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018
items.q: And the judges of course: Grachan Moncur, Julian Priester, Steve Davis, Curtis Fuller, you know.

ctx.x: So it didn’t depend — if you only worked twice in a week you were getting a salary.

Which that never happened but yeah. Yeah you got a small salary. But they would give raises from time to time depending on who was asking. And then also I had the — Maynard wanted me to stay towards the end of my time with him, so I did a record, my first record. I was allowed to open the show for him, sell my CDs, again, this was just slightly before the MP3 download thing got really big. So I was selling CDs after the show for twenty dollars a CD. So by the end of my stay I was actually doing pretty well with…

became aware of what else existed out there. Andre Hayward won that competition. I met — re-connected with Andre there, re-connected with Steve Davis, Elliot Mason was a competitor, Marshall Gilkes, all these great trombone players. And the judges of course: Grachan Moncur, Julian Priester, Steve Davis, Curtis Fuller, you know. And then of course Herbie Hancock is there, Wayne Shorter is there, all the Monk Institute people. So that was a time for me when I thought wow this is, now I’m getting a view of what’s…
